note: Public listing of the hosted provider as of 2026-10-02: input price about 4 cents per million tokens, output free, 32k tokens for state plus questions behind the gateway. The row names no endpoint: a push leaves the decider on the base_url its set gives it (PRESENTER_DECIDE_BASE_URL), so it never moves the decider to an origin outside its base_url_allow. max_output 0: a decisions row answers typed decisions, not completions, so no output limit applies (GH #1037). input_hard 32000 = the whole 32k gateway window (a decisions call has no completion to leave room for), input_soft 8000 = 25 % of it; no cache price is listed, so cost_cached_in and cost_cache_write are 0 (2026-10-06, R-HK-15/16).
strengths: Typed decisions only: answers choice, yes/no and scale questions about one state, with probabilities, in a few hundred milliseconds and for a fraction of a cent. Generates no text and calls no tools.
